card.name: Words just before group or meeting
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected noun such as group, meeting, chapter or class, mostly in support-group or gathering settings. Often the word 'support', a disease name, or a verb like 'attend'.

modes.label: Before 'groups'
modes.description: The word 'support' or a disease name that is followed by 'group'.
modes.example: - Psoriasis<< support>> groups - Stress management classes -

modes.label: Attending gatherings
modes.description: A verb or modifier that leads into a meeting, class or chapter.
modes.example: Parents may be able to<< attend>> a breakfast meeting before work.

modes.label: Organization names
modes.description: Words inside names of councils, unions or conferences, before a meeting-type noun.
modes.example: Published in: Actas de la XII Reunión<< de>> la Economía Mundial

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for meetings, clubs and get-togethers.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'group' or 'meeting', when the text is about people getting together.
